<reason>B won the live comparison: shortage policy is judged by physical withdrawals now, and a tariff can miss that target even with perfect compliance because paying is allowed. A's "set the jump high enough" assumed the conservation result it needed, and A's opening fairness story (apartment vs estate) was reversed once B forced a pool/lawn ban into the comparison.
